benchmarks.name: ADE-bench
benchmarks.description: dbt Labs benchmark for AI agents on analytics and data engineering tasks in sandboxed dbt projects, with task variants for DuckDB and Snowflake.
benchmarks.created_source: GitHub repository creation date (no paper found)
benchmarks.notes: Harbor ships an adapter (harbor-framework/harbor adapters/adebench) that converts ADE-bench tasks to Harbor task.toml.

benchmarks.name: BIRD
benchmarks.description: Large-scale database-grounded text-to-SQL benchmark with real-world databases and external-knowledge evidence; the Mini-Dev subset ships SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL variants.
benchmarks.notes: Original BIRD code lives in AlibabaResearch/DAMO-ConvAI (bird/); the repository URL here points at the maintained Mini-Dev release.

benchmarks.name: BIRD-Interact
benchmarks.description: Interactive text-to-SQL benchmark where agents resolve ambiguous requests through dialogue with a user simulator, in conversational (c-Interact) and agentic (a-Interact) modes on PostgreSQL.
benchmarks.notes: A larger variant is published as https://huggingface.co/datasets/birdsql/bird-interact-full.

benchmarks.name: DA-Code
benchmarks.description: Agent data science code generation benchmark with sandboxed execution and file-based workflows.
benchmarks.notes: Upstream README reviewed on 2026-10-23. Benchmark-level entry only; representative task annotations and pinned task evidence have not yet been added. Dates are left unknown rather than estimated.

support.notes: Support is based on the upstream README, not verified task-level usage.

benchmarks.name: DABStep
benchmarks.description: Adyen and Hugging Face benchmark of multi-step data-analysis questions over payments data (transactions, fees, merchant metadata) supplied as CSV, JSON and Markdown files.
benchmarks.created_source: Hugging Face dataset creation date (no paper found)
benchmarks.notes: No GitHub repository; the dataset and leaderboard are hosted on Hugging Face. Agents may use any tooling to answer.

benchmarks.name: data-eng-bench
benchmarks.description: Snowflake Labs data-engineering benchmark for coding agents: 103 dbt tasks on a retail warehouse, each runnable on DuckDB or Snowflake, packaged as Harbor tasks.
benchmarks.created_source: GitHub repository creation date (no paper found)

support.notes: Backend chosen per run with DB_TYPE=duckdb|snowflake.

benchmarks.name: DataSciBench
benchmarks.description: Data science agent benchmark spanning data exploration, predictive modeling, visualization and scientific computing.
benchmarks.notes: Upstream README reviewed on 2026-10-23. Benchmark-level entry only; representative task annotations and pinned task evidence have not yet been added. Dates are left unknown rather than estimated.

support.notes: Support is based on the upstream README, not verified task-level usage.

benchmarks.name: DSAgentBench
benchmarks.description: 275 end-to-end data-science tasks performed by computer-use agents in a real Ubuntu desktop (VS Code, Jupyter), built on OSWorld and scored by task-specific evaluators.
benchmarks.notes: Identified as the vis-nlp/DSAgentBench repository linked from arXiv 2608.10366; no other benchmark with this name was found.

benchmarks.name: DSBench
benchmarks.description: Data science agent benchmark (ICLR 2025) with data analysis questions from ModelOff/Eloquens and data modeling tasks from Kaggle competitions.
benchmarks.notes: Task files are distributed as a separate data archive; per-task file formats were not verified.

benchmarks.name: ELT-Bench++
benchmarks.description: End-to-end ELT pipeline benchmark: agents configure Airbyte extraction/loading from heterogeneous sources and build transformation models in a cloud warehouse. ELT-Bench++ is the current default branch of the ELT-Bench repository.
benchmarks.created_source: arXiv 2504.04808 v1 submission (original ELT-Bench paper; no separate ELT-Bench++ paper found)
benchmarks.updated_source: Latest commit on the elt_bench++ branch (fcf3129)

support.notes: README lists Snowflake, Databricks and Redshift versions.

benchmarks.name: Spider 2.0
benchmarks.description: Enterprise text-to-SQL and data workflow tasks over BigQuery, Snowflake, SQLite and DuckDB/dbt projects (sub-sets: Spider 2.0-Lite, Spider 2.0-Snow, Spider 2.0-DBT).
benchmarks.notes: README (2026-08-12) reports the shared Snowflake evaluation account is temporarily suspended.

support.notes: Lite mixes BigQuery, Snowflake and local SQLite databases; Snow is Snowflake-only; DBT uses local DuckDB files.

benchmarks.name: Spider2-V
benchmarks.description: Multimodal agent benchmark of data science and engineering workflows executed through GUIs and terminals in an Ubuntu VM (BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Airbyte, Jupyter, Superset and more).
benchmarks.notes: Dataset URL is the VM image; task JSON files live in the repository under evaluation_examples/examples/<app>/.

support.notes: App folders in the repository: airbyte, airflow, bigquery, dagster, dbt, excel, jupyter, metabase, servicenow, snowflake, superset. Client names are mapped from those folders.

tasks.name: Fix outdated dbt_utils.surrogate_key compile error across models
tasks.notes: Agent works in a terminal (tmux) inside a Docker sandbox. task.yaml declares four variants; solution_seeds compare dim_listings_hosts and the *_agg_reviews tables.

configurations.label: DuckDB · dbt Core
configurations.notes: variant: db_type duckdb, project_type dbt. Shared .duckdb databases are published as GitHub release assets (README).

configurations.label: Snowflake · dbt Core
configurations.notes: variant: db_type snowflake, project_type dbt, migration_directory airbnb__duckdb_to_snowflake. Connection via SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT/USER/PASSWORD environment variables.

configurations.label: Snowflake · dbt Fusion
configurations.notes: variant: db_type snowflake, project_type dbt-fusion, migration_directory airbnb__duckdb_to_snowflake_dbtf.

tasks.name: Ratio of customers paying in EUR vs CZK (debit_card_specializing)
tasks.notes: question_id 1471, db_id debit_card_specializing, difficulty simple, split mini_dev_sqlite. Gold answer is a SQLite query (uses IIF). Databases ship as .sqlite files under mini_dev_data/dev_databases per the README. Client and interaction depend on the system under test, so they are left unknown.

tasks.name: Atmospheric Observability Index by weather condition (a-Interact)
tasks.notes: selected_database 'alien', category Query. Sample file uses mode a-interact: the agent calls tools, including asking a user simulator to clarify the ambiguous query. PostgreSQL is stated at benchmark level (README, Docker services).

tasks.name: Alien database query in conversational mode (c-Interact)
tasks.notes: Sample file uses mode c-interact (trajectory includes an ask_user tool call).

tasks.name: Total fees owed by Belles_cookbook_store on day 12 of 2023
tasks.notes: Level hard; answer must be a number rounded to 2 decimals. Shared context files include payments.csv, fees.json, merchant_data.json and manual.md; which ones this task needs is inferred. The benchmark does not prescribe a language or engine, so those stay unknown.

tasks.name: Build a cohort retention matrix dbt model for marketing channels
tasks.notes: instruction.md: the live $DB_TYPE selects DuckDB or Snowflake; create models/marts/marketing/cohort_retention_matrix.sql in schema marketing_analytics. Verified by pytest against the materialised table.

configurations.label: Snowflake
configurations.notes: DB_TYPE=snowflake; the entrypoint creates a per-task clone database and sets SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE.

tasks.name: Find third-highest correlated wine feature with pandas in VS Code
tasks.notes: Instruction: 'Using Visual Studio Code, create a new Python script ... Load it using pandas ...' Setup downloads winequality-red.csv and launches 'code'; result.txt holds the answer.

tasks.name: ModelOff 2016 round 1 section 2: 'Chip off the old block'
tasks.notes: Data analysis task with questions 6-18 (multiple choice and numeric answers). Language inferred from the evaluation notebooks; engine and file formats not verified.

tasks.name: Kaggle Titanic survival prediction
tasks.notes: Data modeling task linked to https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/titanic (2012). Competition file formats not verified from the repository.

tasks.name: Build the 'address' ELT pipeline into Snowflake (states model)
tasks.notes: config.yaml: Airbyte public API server, sources aws_s3 (CBSA.jsonl via LocalStack), flat_files (CSV from Google Drive), postgres, mongodb and custom_api; destination Snowflake. data_model.yaml defines target model 'states'. Transformation language not verified.

tasks.name: GA4: distinct pseudo users with engagement in 7-day but not 2-day window
tasks.notes: Spider 2.0-Lite record with db 'ga4'; the database is listed under spider2-lite/resource/databases/bigquery/. Client and interaction come from the benchmark's BigQuery interface (bigquery.Client()), not from the task record. Output format and physical storage are not stated.

tasks.name: E-commerce: 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales
tasks.notes: Spider 2.0-Lite record with db 'E_commerce' (schema JSON and DDL.csv under resource/databases/sqlite/E_commerce/). The .sqlite files are downloaded separately per the README.

tasks.name: Complete dbt project for traffic-source attribution metrics
tasks.notes: profiles.yml declares 'type: duckdb, path: ./playbook.duckdb'; evaluation (gold/spider2_eval.jsonl) uses duckdb_match against playbook.duckdb on table attribution_touches. The .duckdb file itself is downloaded separately.

tasks.name: GA4 engagement question, Snowflake edition
tasks.notes: Spider 2.0-Snow record (db_id 'GA4'); the Snow subset is Snowflake-only. Access via snowflake.connector.connect() with a credential file is the benchmark's reference interface; Snowsight GUI access is also documented.

tasks.name: Load JSONL from Google Drive into a BigQuery table via the web UI
tasks.notes: related_apps: bigquery, chromium; setup launches Google Chrome and logs into BigQuery and Google Drive. Source is data.jsonl plus schema.txt in Drive; the evaluator exports information.data1 to CSV and compares with gold.csv (CSV is an evaluation artifact, not BigQuery's storage).

tasks.name: Filter Airflow DAGs by owner in the Astronomer web UI
tasks.notes: related_apps: airflow, chromium; Airflow deployed locally with Astronomer (astro) at localhost:8080. Orchestration task with no table data.
